subject: Re: Market evidence counteroffer + proposed switch timeline
messages:
From: Vikram Shah <vikram@edgeflow.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgeflow.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing gap + timeline for potential switch

Hey Karthik,

Thanks for the call earlier — the team shared the procurement packet and the numbers from our incumbent. I attached the spreadsheet procurement asked us to use for vendor comparisons (edgeflow_rfp-pricing-sheet.xlsx).

Short version: incumbent has offered a 28% blended discount and an onboarding credit that compresses Year 1 cost by ~35%. Our CFO wants a concrete counteroffer with market evidence that justifies an equivalent economic outcome or a clear migration timeline that reduces perceived risk.

Can you send a structured counteroffer (credits vs. discount vs. pilot pricing) + a suggested switch timeline that keeps their production stable? Ideally before next Friday so procurement can include it in the vendor review.

Appreciate it,
Vikram
Vikram Shah, Head of Product
EdgeFlow AI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vikram Shah <vikram@edgeflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing gap + timeline for potential switch

Vikram — thanks for the packet and the call. Quick reply with what we'll do next:

1) I'll build a short counteroffer that breaks down: a) immediate onboarding credit, b) blended per-token discount tiers, and c) a short pilot pricing path that mirrors incumbent economics but with tighter SLOs.
2) Marissa will validate the commercial math and recommend the credit vs discount mix.
3) Jonas will draft a guarded operational rollback plan (30/60/90) so procurement can see a low-risk migration path.

Target: send a formal PDF counteroffer + spreadsheet by Thursday EOD (Dec 3). If procurement wants earlier, tell me a hard deadline.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing gap + timeline for potential switch

Karthik — added a few notes after a quick pass on the spreadsheet Vikram sent. Key thoughts:

- If we match the full 35% Year 1 compression with credits, we can do it but it eats ~40% of projected ARR value in the first 12 months. Better to structure as a 20% upfront credit + 12% blended rate discount across committed tiers.
- Add a firmness clause: 6-month renewal at the committed tier to recover economics.
- Recommend including a technical onboarding credit tied to specific milestones (pilot, 1st prod run, full shift) instead of a big one-off. This preserves ops motion and reduces rollback risk.

I'll assemble sample numbers and export a tidy counteroffer PDF. Jonas — I'll need your 30/60/90 operations bullets to attach.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Deals, MidMarket
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vikram Shah <vikram@edgeflow.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing gap + timeline for potential switch

Vikram — attaching high level migration guardrails.

Short summary: we recommend a phased switch with three guarded checkpoints:

- Phase A (pilot, 2–4 weeks): isolated traffic to Redwood sandbox, success criteria = latency within 1.2x baseline, no data loss, runbook validated.
- Phase B (staged ramp, 4–8 weeks): 10% → 50% traffic ramp with real-time KPIs and rollback toggle. We include an automated fallback to incumbent for 30 minutes while logs/metrics stabilize.
- Phase C (full cutover, 2–4 weeks): final swap after two weeks of stable performance at 90% traffic.

Ops credits: we propose milestone-based credits (pilot complete, staged ramp complete, go-live) that sum to the onboarding bucket.

I'll send a short ops playbook (runbooks, key contacts, escalation matrix) as an appendix.

Jonas
Jonas Weber | Director, ProdOps Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Vikram Shah <vikram@edgeflow.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing gap + timeline for potential switch

Team — this is very helpful. Procurement asked for two things before they can recommend Redwood: 1) a line-item counteroffer that shows exact Year 1 cost under each scenario (credits vs discount vs pilot), and 2) three references who've executed migrations in regulated environments.

Can you provide the line-item by Wednesday (Dec 9) and references? Also, can you confirm whether the onboarding credits are refundable if procurement asks for a performance SLA that we miss? They flagged legal language about "credit clawbacks".

-Vikram
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vikram Shah <vikram@edgeflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Market evidence counteroffer + proposed switch timeline

Vikram — attached: redwood_market-evidence-counteroffer.pdf and an exported line-item sheet that maps Year 1 spend across three scenarios (credits-heavy, blended discount, pilot-first). Summary below:

- Recommend: 20% onboarding credit (milestone-based) + 10% blended rate discount on committed tiers for 12 months. Net Year 1 change ~-31% vs incumbent in the spreadsheet when factoring credits + tighter latency SLOs.
- Credits are milestone-tied and non-refundable; if a performance SLA is missed we offer a remediation credit structure (service credit applied to future invoices) rather than cash refunds. This addresses legal's clawback concern while limiting our financial exposure.
- References: we provided three anonymized reference contacts (regulated fintech, healthcare analytics, and e-commerce platform) along with exec summaries and go-live dates.

If procurement confirms they need DocuSign, I can send the updated term sheet and set up a redline window with your legal team. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_market-evidence-counteroffer.pdf, edgeflow_rfp-pricing-sheet.xlsx
